title: Reported Speech
description: How do you report what somebody **said**, **asked** or **told you to do**? Read the rules first, then practise step by step.

subtopics.title: 1 Statements
subtopics.description: Backshift of tenses, pronouns, time and place expressions.

subtopics.title: 2 Questions
subtopics.description: Questions with a question word and yes/no questions with *if* or *whether*.

subtopics.title: 4 Mixed practice
subtopics.description: Statements, questions and commands all together.
